args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'.
- The old name in that saved report is out of date and should be updated to Pellow Home Living.

Sent on behalf of Sofia Marchetti (Coastal team).

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion, from Sofia Marchetti (Coastal team):

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'.
- That saved report should be updated to Pellow Home Living.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Requested by Bettina Kroll (Coastal team lead).

args.text: @Bettina Kroll, I've saved the note to June Osei-Lark as a draft with the subject 'PHL label cleanup'. It includes Sofia's bullets plus your two lines on the Pellucid (Gulf Coast terminal) and Pellow (Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments) rows. It is not sent.

I saved the draft to June Osei-Lark with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It is not sent. It has Sofia's bullets plus your two lines on the Pellucid and Pellow rows. I posted a confirmation in the #coastal-team thread.

Note that the draft is in my mailbox, not Sofia's. The earlier draft with the subject "PHL label confusion" is also there, so you may want to delete one of them before June sees either.
